modelFacts: Evaluation status: Evaluated on held-out speakers
Emotion classes: Angry, Disgust, Fear, Happy, Neutral, Sad
Architecture: StandardScaler then SVC (SVC, parameters: C=5, class_weight=balanced, gamma=scale, kernel=rbf, max_iter=-1)
Sample rate and input: 16000 Hz. mono speech, resampled to 16 kHz in the backend; 0.5 to 6 seconds of speech are analysed
